title: Tiro 파형 — 맥락 사물 4종 리뷰 (원본 SteppedWave, 그래픽 전용 사본)
what_this_is: A compact graphics-only review reference. It is a candidate generation direction the user liked (2026-10-21), NOT a globally adopted/canonical waveform treatment and NOT product-UI evidence.

route_summary.object_selection: Semantically related Tiro conversation/record/organize objects were chosen, not objects picked only for visual shape (shell/stone/coil were visual-only candidates and are superseded for this route).
route_summary.render_direction: stepped-medium, 60 carriers, horizontal axis, continuous slow flow, paper-ink mask.
route_summary.color: Dark review preset only: fg #CAC0B6, opacity 0.299, bg #191614. From the source snapshot. NOT adopted global tokens.
route_summary.pipeline_honesty: imagegen was used ONLY to produce the 3D source photos. There is NO fake hand-drawn waveform. The waveform is the exact original native HTML rendering. No Python approximate renderer, blur, stretch, or gamma rewrite was used for the waveform.

provenance.lineage_note: Native waveform renderers are byte-identical copies from the working build (build/original/*). The per-object input field data (horizontal-fields.js), native class mapping, grid placement, and layout are NEW inputs documented below; they do not claim to have existed in the original source.

new_inputs_documented.note: Mapping/grids/placement are documented new DATA permitted for this object set; the native style/algorithm is unchanged.

renderer_bytes_preserved.note: Native renderer bytes preserved. stepped-wave.js must match the required SHA below.

renderer/horizontal-fields.js.role: Per-object input field data (base64 grids) needed to make the review HTML render without the full product build. New DATA input, not original source.

review.html.role: Self-contained animated review derived from the latest work index.html, repointed to the local renderer/ copies and sources-thumb/. Uses the exact native rendering.

source_thumbnails.note: 480px downscaled copies for a portable in-browser original-compare. Full-resolution sources live in the working folder; their SHAs are recorded below for provenance.

portable_in_this_package: Self-contained review.html (opens directly in a browser, animated)
local_only_not_packaged: Full-resolution source PNGs (~1.3MB each) and full-size 1080/320 output PNGs + SVGs
Full QA set (render-report, final-export-check, equality, hash-receipt)
Build adapter/export scripts and whole product/UI simulation

Reason: keep the reference compact and avoid shipping a product simulation or customer data. The review HTML plus the renderer snapshot and this documented pipeline are enough to review the direction; regenerate full outputs from the working folder if needed.

known_review_notes.readability: Objects should read yet blend into the waveform; labels alone cannot rescue an unreadable crop. Apply the skill crop recognizability gate at full size and 320px.
known_review_notes.notebook-pen: Weak identifiability was noted as an improvement item, not a universal PASS.
